name: Herbert Hoover Birthplace Cottage

dates.altered: The survey's data form: 'Moved and attached to rear of 2-story house in 1885; returned to original location and restored in 1938 by McKay Construction Company; further restoration in 1962, William Wagner, architect.' The Park Service's FAQ tells it differently: 'After the Hoover family sold the Birthplace Cottage in 1878, later owners rotated it 90 degrees, moved it 30 feet west, and attached a larger house. When President and Mrs. Hoover purchased the cottage in 1935, they restored it to its original location and appearance.' Both kept.
dates.note: The survey: 'DATE OF CONSTRUCTION (INCLUDE SOURCE) ca. 1871'; Wikipedia: 'built in the spring of 1871'.

note: The smallest building in the corpus's precedents and the plainest: two rooms, board-and-batten, a shed-roofed one-bay porch -- the 'whatever the mill offered' end of the farmhouse node at 504 sq ft's poorer cousin. The survey is a 1983 short data form, not a full Part II. Seeded 4 Sep 2026.
